title: Horse Armor Crafting
description: Adds a crafting recipe for all horse armor.
body:
# What is this plugin?
This plugin adds crafting recipes for iron, gold, and diamond horse armor

# Where can I find more plugins like this one?
Join the discord with the link on this page or click "ItzzNotVoid" under the creators section on this page.

# Can I modify this plugin?
You may modify this plugin but you must give credit. Click the license on this page for more (Mozilla Lisence 2.0). Source Code is also linked here. Its on mediafire because i don't know hot to use github.
